name: Hytale-Server-Manager
description: Hytale Server Manager is a web-based management dashboard for Hytale game servers. Features include: - Server management and monitoring - Backup automation and restoration - Player tracking - Mod management - Scheduled tasks - Discord notifications - Real-time console access IMPORTANT: You must configure the JWT secrets before first use. Generate random values for JWT_SECRET, JWT_REFRESH_SECRET, and SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY using the commands shown in each variable's description.

paths.name: Certificates
paths.description: SSL Certificates for the web UI

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID for file permissions. Use 'id' command to find your UID.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for file permissions. Use 'id' command to find your GID.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Set container timezone in TZ format.

variables.name: CORS_ORIGIN
variables.description: Allowed CORS origin. Set to your Unraid server URL for external access (e.g., https://192.168.1.100:3001)

variables.name: INSECURE_COOKIES
variables.description: Allow HTTP access (NOT recommended). Set to 'true' only for local network testing without HTTPS.

variables.name: SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY
variables.description: Encryption key for sensitive settings (exactly 32 hex chars). Generate with: openssl rand -hex 16

variables.name: JWT_REFRESH_SECRET
variables.description: JWT refresh token secret (min 32 chars). Generate with: openssl rand -hex 64

variables.name: JWT_SECRET
variables.description: JWT secret for authentication (min 32 chars). Generate with: openssl rand -hex 64

variables.name: RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW
variables.description: Rate limit window in milliseconds (default: 900000 = 15 minutes)

variables.name: RATE_LIMIT_MAX
variables.description: Maximum requests per rate limit window (default: 100)

variables.name: MAX_FILE_UPLOAD_SIZE
variables.description: Maximum file upload size in bytes (default: 52428800 = 50MB)
